content: Board game cafe/club ops SaaS (TWICE, GameLedger, GameShelf) bundle: BGG-powered inventory import, QR-code-at-table checkout/return, table/session reservations & scheduling, membership tracking, usage analytics, low-stock/maintenance alerts, and in some cases game discovery/recommendations layered on the catalog. Core rental primitive is simple: copy status (available/checked-out), who has it, when due back.
